SP Flash Tool GUI bena dayɛlɛ sisan n’i ka porogramu fitinin be yen ka kɔn.

support_story_1_headline: Ni dilanbagaw be taga ɲɛfɛ, sigidamɔgɔw be wuli.
support_story_1_lead: Ka i ka minan tanga ka bɔ nɛgɛjuruw ma ani yɛlɛmani tiɲɛninw ma.
support_story_1_body: Innioasis be to ka porogramu kuraw bɔ tulonkɛlaw kama i n’a fɔ Y1 (minw ɲɛsinna board dogoninw yɛlɛmaniw ma i n’a fɔ 6.0, 7.0 ani 8.0) minw be minan kɔrɔw tiɲɛ nɔgɔman na. Min ka jugu n’o bɛɛ ye, u ka site web tɛ lasɔmini foyi di ani u tɛ se ka porogramu kɔrɔw sɔrɔ minw tun be baara kɛra walisa ka se ka bɔ briki cogoya la. Lakurayali ani Community Firmware poroze be fɛnw ta: an be ROM kɔrɔmanw bɛɛ mara, an b’i ka minanw yɛlɛmani sɛgɛsɛgɛ o yɛrɛ ma ani an b’a to i ka tulonkɛla be baara kɛ lafiya la.
support_story_1_item_1: Ka tulonkɛlaw kisi minw tiɲɛna: Lakanali sɛgɛsɛgɛri b’a to yɛlɛmani kuraw tɛ minan kɔrɔw tiɲɛ abada.
support_story_1_item_2: ROM minw marala: Innioasis ka porogramu fɔlɔw bɛɛ lajɛnnin lo.
support_story_1_item_3: Platform min be sɔrɔ yɔrɔ caaman na: Baarakɛminanw be se ka yɛlɛma macOS, Linux ani Windows bɛɛ kan.
support_story_1_item_4: Hardware Intelligence: A be tablo lɔn a yɛrɛ ma walisa i ka pake ɲuman sɔrɔ tuma bɛɛ.
support_story_2_headline: Google Diskw tiɲɛnin tɛ. Miiri-baara tɛ. Lozisiyɛli fitinin dɔrɔn lo be baara kɛra.
support_story_2_lead: Sigida baarakɛminɛnw minw ka teli ani u sɛgɛsɛgɛra, i be se k’i jigi la u kan tiɲɛn na.
support_story_2_body: Ka Innioasis porogramu ofisiyɛli nɔfɛtagama, a ka ca a la, o kɔrɔ ye ka forɔmuw sɛgɛsɛgɛ ka Google Drive ka yɔrɔw sɛgɛsɛgɛ minw ka wagati banna, Baidu ka sankaba tilanyɔrɔw salenw ani zip file gundomanw minw tɛ ni baarakɛminanw ye minw be yɛlɛmayɛlɛma. An ye réseau dɔ lɔ min be se ka la a la ani a be se ka telesarse a yɛrɛ ma ani a be ni SHA-256 tilenninya sɛgɛsɛgɛnin ye, a be kunnafoni kuraw di ani a be mɔgɔw bilasira yɔrɔ o yɔrɔ. I ka nilifɛnw be fɛɛn minw telesarse ani k’u mara, o lo b’a to o be se ka kɛ lɛrɛ 24 kɔnɔ tile kɔnɔ, tile 365 kɔnɔ saan kɔnɔ.
support_story_2_item_1: Direct High-Speed ​​CDN: A be se ka telesarse joona ani a tɛ se ka telesarse dan ani a tɛ yɔrɔ salenw sɔrɔ.
support_story_2_item_2: Ladilikanw kurakurayali: Ni jamakulu ka fɛɛn kuraw bɔra wala n’u labɛnna, i ka lasɔmi.
support_story_2_item_3: Installation guidée étape par étape: Yirali gwɛninw b’i dɛmɛ ka butɔnw digi tuma o tuma.
support_story_2_item_4: Kan caaman fɔbagaw ka jɛnkulu: A be fɔ Angilɛkan, Sinuwakan, Alemaɲikan, Ɛsipaɲikan, Faransikan ani Zapɔnkan na.
support_story_3_headline: Ka i ka Innioasis tulonkɛla ka setigiya bɛɛ dayɛlɛ.
support_story_3_lead: Ka na ni Rockbox ye, baarakɛcogo nɔgɔmanw, ani lamɛnnikɛlaw ka hɔɔrɔnya.
support_story_3_body: I ka Y1 wala Y2 ka minanw be se ka min kɛ, porogramu minw be sɔrɔ iziniw kɔnɔ, u b’o lo sɛgɛsɛgɛ dɔrɔn. An ka sigida ye Rockbox, operatɛri nɔgɔmanw, kodɛki minw be lamɛn ani barokun minw be mɔgɔw lasun u ka koow kɛ, olu lawuli. An be minanw yɛlɛmaniw san an ka wari kɔnɔ walisa k’u sɛgɛsɛgɛ, k’u yɛlɛma ani k’u donyɔrɔ bɛɛ sɛgɛsɛgɛ. Ka Lakurayali dɛmɛ, o be wari di o kɔrɔbɔli yɔrɔw ma ani ka porogramu fitininw labɛn joona joona.
support_story_3_item_1: Rockbox min be digi yɔrɔ kelen na: Odiofiliw be se ka lamɛn ani ka barokunw don i ka ɔridinatɛri kɔnɔ sekɔndi damanin kɔnɔ.
support_story_3_item_2: Community Firmware: Battery enhancements, cleaner UI, and modern audio codec support.
support_story_3_item_3: Active Hardware Lab: An be sɛgɛsɛgɛri kɛ minan yɛrɛ yɛrɛw kan sanni an ka boon si bɔ.
support_story_3_item_4: Zero Bloatware: 100% lozisiyɛli min be sɔrɔ gwansan, a be mɔgɔ ka kunnafoniw mara fɔlɔ ani a tɛ pibilisitew wala mɔgɔw nɔfɛtagama.
support_story_4_headline: Innioasis tɛ min kɛ, an dɛmɛ k’o kɛ.
support_story_4_lead: Sigida ka lozisiyɛli fitinin marali min b'i ka minanw mara nɔgɔw bilayɔrɔw la.
support_story_4_body: Ni minanw dilanyɔrɔ dɔ be taga n’u ka minan wɛrɛ ye, u be minan kɔrɔw to yen. Innioasis tɛ Linux dɛmɛ foyi di, yɛlɛmaniw be kɛ cogo gwɛnin na ani cogo nɔgɔman tɛ yen min be se k’a to i be se ka yɛlɛma n’i ka installation ma ɲɛ. Lakurayali be yen sabu baarakɛlaw minw be baara kɛ ni kanuya ye, olu man ɲi ka miziki fɔlan ɲuman dafanin dɔ fili. Sigida ka bolomafara 100% be taga yɔrɔnin kelen ka baarakɛminɛn nin dayɛlɛ bɛɛ ye.
support_story_4_item_1: Rescue & Unbrick: A sɛgɛsɛgɛra ko kɛnɛyali be kɛ hali ni minanw banna ka baara kɛ.
support_story_4_item_2: Linux ka dɛmɛ fɔlɔ: MediaTek min be yɛlɛmayɛlɛma Linux distros kan, o be dɛmɛ dafalen di.
support_story_4_item_3: Yɛlɛmani minw be kɛ, u be gwɛ: U be bɔli sɛbɛw kɔnɔ ka gwɛ walisa i k’a lɔn tigitigi yɛlɛmani minw be kɛra.
support_story_4_item_4: 100% Jamana ka wari: Kafe kelen kelen bɛɛ be sɛbɛnw marayɔrɔ dayɛlɛ ani bɛɛ be se k’u sara gwansan.

linux_usb_grant_desc: I ka sira di siɲɛ kelen walisa porogramu ka se ka kumaɲɔgɔnya kɛ n’i ka ɔridinatɛri ye.
linux_perms_ok_msg: USB ka yamaruyaw & udev sariyaw donna ka ɲɛ. Baarakɛyɔrɔw labɛnnin lo.
donate_rely_on_you: An b’an jigi la aw ka nilifɛnw kan walisa ka to ka baara kɛ. Nili kɛ sisan
flash_sp_gui_tooltip: MediyaTek SP ka baarakɛminan GUI dayɛlɛ
status_app_reset_defaults: Aplikasiyɔn bilara ka kɛ a kɔrɔ ye pewu, telesarse marayɔrɔ tununa, ani batiri hakilijigi bilara kokura.
log_app_reset_defaults: App ka kɔnfiguration yɛlɛmana pewu ka kɛ i n'a fɔ a tun be cogo min na fɔlɔ la, telesarse cache tununa, ani batiri hakilijigi laseginna (R).
flash_watch_waiting: Ka kɔnɔni kɛ i ka tulonkɛla ka daminɛ tugun...
flash_watch_waiting_hint: A to a ka don i ka telefɔni na — Rockbox be baara daminɛna ani a ka barokunw bena fara a kan a yɛrɛ ma.
flash_watch_found: Tulonkɛla lɔnna — ka Rockbox barokunw fara a kan...
flash_watch_timeout: I ka tulonkɛla ma segi ka na fɔlɔ.
flash_watch_timeout_hint: A filɛ n’a be nɛgɛjuru kɔnɔ ani n’a be yɛlɛla. N’a tora dibi la, i ka pin dɔ digi reset woo kɔnɔ ani i ka cɛmancɛ butɔn (Y1) wala fanga butɔn (tulonkɛla wɛrɛw) minɛ walisa k’a lawuli tugun. Ni a bele tɛna daminɛ, porogramu fitinin ma ta — dɔ wɛrɛ don.
action_searching: Minɛn ɲinina (a to a ka kuran na)...
action_brom_detected: Minɛn min yera BROM cogoya la...
action_downloading_da: DA telesarse ka don minɛn kɔnɔ...
action_flash_complete: Flash dafara! USB bɔ a la ani i k’a lawuli tugun.
task_writing_system: Lozisiyɛli min be sisitɛmu kɔnɔ, o sɛbɛri
action_recover_powercycle: Fanga-cycle tulonkɛla (fanga minɛ ~10s), ka sɔrɔ k'a nɔrɔ tugun - lajɛ tugun...
action_wait_mtk: MTK ka minɛn kɔnɔna... Minɛn ka fanga faga ani ka USB don a la.
action_da_stall: Minɛn y'a dabila ka baara kɛ tuma min na a tun be telesarse baarakɛla labɛnnin lo. A faga pewu, i k’a don tugun ani i k’a lajɛ tugun.
action_detected_preloader: Minɛn lɔnna (minɛn min be don ka kɔn) - telesarsebaga labɛnni...
action_da_wait_back: Tulonkɛla y’a dabila ka jaabili di k’a to a be telesarse agent daminɛna. Ka kɔnɔni kɛ a ka segi ka na...
action_device_connected: Minɛn nɔrɔnin lo - sɛbɛnni cikanw labɛnni...
action_formatting: Ka baarakɛla ka kunnafoniw ani cache labɛn...
action_restart_brom: Ka tulonkɛlan lawuli tugun ka don BROM cogoya la...
log_install_writing: A sigili be senna - ka lozisiyɛli fitinin jaaw sɛbɛ...
log_sparse_fmt: Android ja dɔɔnin yera {part} kama, a be yɛlɛma baara la...
err_code_connection_failed: A ma se ka nɔrɔ minɛn na
err_code_mtk_init_failed: MTK ka sannikɛla ma se ka daminɛ
err_code_no_scatter: Fayili jɛnsɛnnin si tɛ pake kɔnɔ
err_code_missing_images: Lozisiyɛli fitinin jaaw tununa pake kɔnɔ
err_sp_wrong_model_title: Modɛli jugu min be ɲɔgɔn minɛ
err_sp_wrong_model: The connected player is a different model than this package targets. Disconnect it, then install the firmware built for this player.
err_sp_timeout: O minan ma tulonkɛla ye abada. A to a ka kuran faga ani k’a bɔ kuran na, o kɔ, n’u y’a ɲini i fɛ, i ka USB juru don a la.
err_sp_brom_startcmd: Tulonkɛla y’a ka fanga lawuli joona kojugu. A faga pewu, o kɔ, a don a la tugun.
err_sp_download_fail: Sɛbɛri tun be tigɛra. USB ka juru n’a ka pɔri ani batiri charge sɛgɛsɛgɛ, o kɔ, a lajɛ tugun.
err_sp_da_init_sync: O telesarse baarakɛla tun tɛ se k’a daminɛ. I ka flash fɛɛrɛ wɛrɛ lajɛ.
err_sp_brom_da_fail: O telesarsekɛla tun tɛ se ka ci ka taga n’a ye. A faga ani i k’a don tugun.
err_sp_com_port: The tool could not open its serial port. Close other flashing tools and reconnect.
err_com_port_reboot_suggestion: USB COM yɔrɔ tun tɛ se ka dayɛlɛ (fili 1013). N’i ​​y’i ka ɔridinatɛri lawuli tugun, o bena yɔrɔ datugunin bɔ. I k'i ka ɔridinatɛri lawuli kokura k'a lajɛ tugun.
err_sp_enable_dram: O minan tun tɛ se ka tulonkɛla hakili daminɛ. Baara kɛ ni pake ye min dilanna o modɛli tigitigi kama.
err_sp_storage_read: O minan tun tɛ se ka tulonkɛla ka marayɔrɔ kalan. Aw ye ɲɔgɔndan sɛgɛsɛgɛ; n’a sɔrɔ o minan ka minan dɔ tiɲɛna.
err_attempt_timeout: Minɛn min be yɛlɛmayɛlɛma, o ma ɲɛtaga foyi yira {seconds} kɔnɔ, o la, o laɲini lalɔra.
err_connection_failed_desc: A ma se ka jɛnɲɔgɔnya basiginin sigi ni tulonkɛla ye. A’ y’a filɛ ni minan faganin lo (aw ka pin dɔ ta ka reset butɔn digi n’a mako be o la), USB bɔ nɛgɛjuru la ani n’a y’a ɲini aw fɛ, aw k’a don tugun.
err_flash_write_failed_desc: Flashing tun tigɛra wala sɛbɛri baara tun ma ɲɛ. A filɛ ni USB juru donna koɲuman ani ni batiri be ni charge ye ka ɲɛ, o kɔ, a lajɛ tugun.
err_mtk_output_stall_title: A be komi fitinɛ nɔrɔnin lo .
err_mtk_output_stall_desc: Minɛn min be yɛlɛmayɛlɛma, o ye yɔrɔ kelen yira {seconds} labanw na ani a be komi a be to ka porogramu fitinin sɛbɛ. N’a sɔrɔ fitinɛ ma baara kɛ. Ni nin tun ye laɲini fila laban ye ni fɛɛrɛ kelen kelen bɛɛ ye sisitɛmu dɔ kan min be se ka ben u ni ɲɔgɔn cɛ, wala ni MTKClient dɔrɔn lo be sɔrɔ o masin kan, ɔridinatɛri lawuli tugun ani i k’a lajɛ tugun.
err_only_mtkclient_desc: Only MTKClient is available for this install. The flash may have failed. Please restart the computer and try again.
err_mtk_output_stall_fallback_available: This computer can also install using SP Flash Tool. If you can, switch to SP Flash Tool and try again.
prompt_restart_and_quit_desc: N’a sɔrɔ fitinɛ ma baara kɛ. Aw k’o cikan kalan sanfɛ ani aw ka ɔridinatɛri lawuli tugun sanni aw k’a lajɛ tugun. N’i ​​ye OK digi, porogramu bena dabila walisa i ka se k’a daminɛ tugun.
err_missing_package_files_title: Lozisiyɛli fitinin min tɛ baara kɛ
err_missing_package_files_desc: Lozisiyɛli fitinin pake tɛ ni scatter file ye walima jaaw file wajibiyalenw. Aw k’o porogramu telesarse tugun wala ka porogramu fitinin dɔ sugandi.
err_tool_unavailable_title: Minɛn min be mɛnɛmɛnɛ, o tɛ sɔrɔ
err_tool_unavailable_desc: The flashing tool or required system drivers could not be initialized. Please check system permissions, driver setup, or reinstall the application.
err_driver_missing_title: MediaTek USB bolibaga ka kan ka sɔrɔ
err_driver_missing_desc: O fili be se ka kɛ ni MediaTek USB sofɛri ma don. I ka Télécharger Drivers digi walisa ka MediaTek USB sɛrɛkili don i ka ɔridinatɛri kɔnɔ, k’i ka ɔridinatɛri lawuli tugun ani k’a lajɛ tugun.
err_cache_file_missing_desc: Lozisiyɛli fitinin dɔ min maranin be, o tɛ yen. Lozisiyɛli sugandi walisa ka filɛri minw bɔra, u labɛn kokura wala ka porogramu fitininw marayɔrɔ ta tugun. Nin ye yɔrɔ ka file gwɛlɛya ye, USB ka ɲɔgɔndan koo tɛ.
sel_cache_retry_tooltip: Kɔsegi Select Software yɔrɔ la walisa ka porogramu fitininw labɛn kokura wala k’u telesarse.
sel_cache_retry_select_release: Select a firmware release to download again.
err_generic_flash_failed_desc: Fili dɔ kɛra min tun ma lawuli ({detail}). I ka tulonkɛlan faga pewu, n’i y’a ɲini i fɛ, i k’a don tugun ani i k’a lajɛ tugun.
flash_method_confirm: Install fɛɛrɛ yɛlɛmana ka kɛ {method} ye. A sɛgɛsɛgɛ ko tulonkɛlan bɔra kuran na ani ko a fagara, o kɔ, i ka Next digi.
flash_failover_note: {method} did not get the install started. After the player is powered off and unplugged, {other} will be used instead.
themepack_card_desc: Sigida barokun cɛɲumanw, kɔfɛla ɲumanw ani sɛbɛri minw dilanna kɛrɛnkɛrɛnnin na ka ɲɛsin 360p ma, u b’a kɔnɔ.
themepack_step1_title: 1nan: A’ y’a don USB maracogo la .
themepack_step1_desc:
1. I k’i ka tulonkɛlan yɛlɛ n’i ye Power butɔn minɛ.
2. Ni Rockbox be baara kɛra, i ka USB juru don i ka ɔridinatɛri kɔnɔ.
3. N’u y’a ɲini i fɛ i ka USB Storage mode sɛgɛsɛgɛ walisa o minan ka bɔ i n’a fɔ diski.
themepack_step2_title: 2nan: Dosiye o dosiye sugandi min be sɔrɔ tulonkɛlan kan .
themepack_step2_desc: Komi operatɛriw (i n’a fɔ macOS) be dotfiles (i n’a fɔ .rockbox) dogo u yɛrɛ ma, i be se ka dosiye SUGU wala diski lili sugandi i ka tulonkɛlan kan. An bena .rockbox yɔrɔ sɔrɔ wala k’a dilan i ye o yɛrɛ ma.
themepack_complete: Theme pack donna ka ɲɛ! Sisan, i be se k’i ka tulonkɛlan tigɛ hɛɛrɛ la ani ka barokun dɔ sugandi Rockbox kɔnɔ (Paramɛtiriw > Barokunw ka paramɛtiriw).
themepack_err_not_found: A ma se ka .rockbox yɔrɔ dɔ sɔrɔ wala k’a daminɛ diski sugandinin kan. Aw k’aw janto ko aw ye dosiye dɔ sugandi aw ka tulonkɛlan kan.
rockbox_wizard_skip_adb: Ta ka taga USB marayɔrɔ la
rockbox_wizard_reboot_title: 1nan: I ka tulonkɛlan lawuli tugun ani i ka ɲɔgɔn minɛ tugun .
rockbox_wizard_reboot_desc:
1. USB juru bɔ a la.
2. Aw ye yɛlɛma don tugun ani aw k’a to a ka don Rockbox kɔnɔ.
3. Ni Rockbox be baara kɛra ka ban, i ka USB juru don tugun ani i ka Continue digi.
rockbox_wizard_adb_desc: Appli be ADB ka ɲɔgɔndan filɛra (fo ka se sekɔndi 30 ma). Ni minan dɔ sɔrɔla, barokunw be yɛlɛma ani tulonkɛfɛn be lawuli tugun a yɛrɛ ma. N’o tɛ, i ka taga ɲɛfɛ ka taga USB marayɔrɔ la.
rockbox_wizard_adb_searching: ADB ka minan dɔ kɔnɔna... (fo ka se sekɔndi 30 ma)
rockbox_wizard_adb_found: Minɛn min sɔrɔla ({serial}); ka barokunw yɛlɛma...
rockbox_wizard_adb_timeout: ADB minɛn si ma ye sekɔndi 30 kɔnɔ; ka taga ɲɛ ni USB maracogo ye.
rockbox_wizard_no_adb: ADB binari si tɛ sɔrɔ appli kɔnɔ; ka taga ɲɛ ni USB maracogo ye.
rockbox_wizard_adb_pushing: Ka barokunw ni sɛbɛriw yɛlɛma ADB kan...
rockbox_wizard_adb_push_failed: ADB ka yɛlɛmani ma se ka kɛ; ka kɔsegi USB maracogo la
rockbox_wizard_usb_desc:
1. USB Storage Mode lawuli o yɔrɔ la walisa a ka bɔ i n’a fɔ diski.
2. Dosiye SUGU min be sɔrɔ jukɔrɔla la, o sugandi (.rockbox, Miziki, Barokunw, wala diski lili — .rockbox dosiye dogonin dɔ be sɔrɔ a yɛrɛ ma).
3. O porogramu be barokunw ni sɛbɛri 360p fara ɲɔgɔn kan, ka tɔgɔ kelenw sɛbɛ u kan.
rockbox_wizard_done_desc: Sisan, i be se ka tulonkɛlan tigɛ hɛɛrɛ la ani ka barokun dɔ sugandi Rockbox kɔnɔ (Paramɛtiriw > Barokunw ka paramɛtiriw).
rockbox_stage_installing: Rockbox ka barokunw n’a ka sɛbɛriw donni...
rockbox_stage_waiting_adb_fmt: Ka tulonkɛla ɲini ADB sababu la ({remaining}s)...
rockbox_stage_pushing: Player detected. Placing community themes & fonts...
rockbox_wizard_reboot_desc_y1: I ka cɛmancɛ butɔn minɛ walisa k’i ka Y1 lawuli, ka USB don tugun ani ka USB maracogo sugandi.
rockbox_wizard_reboot_desc_power: I ka fanga butɔn minɛ walisa k’i ka pɛrɛnnan lawuli, ka USB don tugun ani ka USB maracogo sugandi.
rockbox_step1_disconnect_power_on: Aw k'aw ka {model} tigɛ ka yɛlɛma, ka sɔrɔ ka Next digi
rockbox_step1_power_on_button: USB tigɛ, {button} minɛ walisa k’i ka {model} lawuli, o kɔ, Next digi.
rockbox_step2_connect_usb: Aw k'aw ka {model} nɔrɔ USB la
rockbox_step_usb_storage_mode: Aw ka USB maracogo yɛlɛma aw ka ɔridinatɛri kɔnɔ ani ka Next digi .
rockbox_step_select_player_folder: Aw k’o tulonkɛla yɛrɛ sugandi wala a ka dosiye dɔ sugandi .
rockbox_power_on_prompt_y1: Hold the center button to power on your Y1 and connect USB.
rockbox_power_on_prompt_other: Hold the power button to power on your {model} and connect USB.
rockbox_ask_running_fmt: Yala Rockbox be baara kɛra i ka {model} kan wa?
rockbox_running_yes: Ɔnhɔn, Rockbox be bolila ka taga .
rockbox_manual_guide:
1. ‘USB Storage Mode’ sugandi i ka telefɔni na.
2. I ka ‘Browse Folder...’ digi walisa k’i ka tulonkɛlan sugandi ani ka barokunw don a la.
rockbox_site_themes_note: Nin Rockbox lɔli be baara kɛ ni barokunw ye minw janya ye 240×320 ye, ani u tɛ ɲɔgɔn minɛ. Aw ka barokunw sɔrɔ aw ka tulonkɛla ye gwansan Rockbox barokunw ka site web kan:
rockbox_troubleshoot_desc: Ni i ka {model} ma wuli, USB bɔ, ka fanga butɔn minɛ 10s kɔnɔ walisa k’a lawuli kokura, ani ka fanga lawuli. Walima i ka porogramu fɔlɔw lasegin u ma.
err_usb_lost_subtitle: Would you like to try again?
legacy_cleanup_desc: Updater kɔrɔ dɔ bele be ɔridinatɛri nin kan ani a be yɔrɔ caaman ta diski kan. N’i ​​y’a bɔ i ka ɔridinatɛri kɔnɔ, o be o yɔrɔ bɔ.
legacy_cleanup_reclaim: A be diski yɔrɔ {size} ɲɔgɔn ɲini tugun
legacy_cleanup_remove_app_cb: Innioasis Updater porogaramu kɔrɔw bɔ ani dɛmɛyɔrɔ minw be sɔrɔ .
legacy_cleanup_keep_platform_tools_cb: Aw ka Android ka baarakɛminanw (ADB / Fastboot) mara .
legacy_cleanup_platform_tools_hint: N’i ​​tɛ baara kɛ ni ADB wala Fastboot ye Lakurayali kɔfɛ, i ka sɛgɛsɛgɛri kɛ walisa k’o yɔrɔ bɔ ani ka yɔrɔ wɛrɛw ɲini tugun.
legacy_cleanup_done_msg: A sera ka legacy installation saniya ani ka diski yɔrɔ sɔrɔ kokura.
legacy_cleanup_card_desc: Updater ka porogramu kɔrɔ dɔ bele be ɔridinatɛri nin kan. N’i ​​y’a bɔ i ka ɔridinatɛri kɔnɔ, o be yɔrɔ bɔ diski la.
legacy_cleanup_confirm_body: O be porogramu kɔrɔ n’a ka dɛmɛfɛnw bɔ yen. Lozisiyɛli fitinin minw telesarsera, u be mara.
legacy_cleanup_tools_body: Yala i be se ka baarakɛminanw (ADB / Fastboot) bɔ yen fana wa? N’i ​​be baara kɛra ni ADB ye, i ka Keep sugandi.
legacy_cleanup_done_inline: A bɔra — a be se ka kɛ {size} ye.
